column1: # github-kit manifest: the single source of truth for what the kit installs and what it verifies.
# (in every installed repo, which also runs in CI via reusable-agent-workflow-verify.yml).
# Adding a template file means adding one line here, not editing six scripts.
# Format: TAB-separated, '#' starts a comment line. Two row kinds:
# <path> is relative to both templates/ (source) and the target repo root (destination).
# <mode> decides what install and update do when the destination already exists:
#   block            managed block: only the text between the template's own
#                    <!-- BEGIN GITHUB-KIT ... --> / <!-- END GITHUB-KIT ... --> lines is kit-owned.
#                    Missing file: the whole template is copied. Content outside markers is never touched.
#   refresh          kit-owned: update overwrites; install overwrites only with --mode force.
#   refresh-exec     same as refresh, then chmod +x.
#   workflow         caller workflow, same as refresh, with `uses: pzoli6/github-kit/...@main`
#                    rewritten to the requested --ref; lines between `# >>> github-kit: repo
#                    workflows >>>` markers are carried over from the existing file.
#   workflow-create  caller workflow that holds repo-specific inputs: created once, never overwritten.
#   workflow-opt     like workflow-create, but only installed with --include-project-sync (or when
#   create           repo-owned after creation: created once, never overwritten, even with --mode force.
#   config           like create, except update --force-config resets it to the template.
#   retired          no longer shipped. Install and update delete the file only when it is byte-for-byte
#                    a version the kit shipped (git blob SHA listed in the 5th column); an edited copy
#                    is kept with a warning. The template is gone from templates/.
# <verify> is the group that makes the file required in verify_agent_workflow.sh:
#   core (always), claude, cursor, skills, gemini (each toggled by a REQUIRE_* switch),
# phrase rows: key phrases that must appear somewhere in the repo's *.md / *.yml / *.yaml files.
# --- retired: no longer installed; removed from repos where unmodified -----------------------
# GitHub Copilot adapter, dropped when the kit stopped supporting Copilot (see AGENTS.md migration notes).
